<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Ortho 2 • Midterm Slide Study — Fresh 165Q</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#07111f; --panel:#0e1d30; --panel2:#13253b; --ink:#eff7ff; --muted:#9fb2c8;
  --line:#28415d; --accent:#64d9c6; --accent2:#7db6ff; --good:#63d49d; --bad:#ff8f8f;
  --warn:#ffd27a; --shadow:0 22px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.28); --radius:22px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;background:
 radial-gradient(circle at 10% -10%,#153861 0,transparent 34%),
 radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0,#12433e 0,transparent 25%),var(--bg);color:var(--ink);min-height:100vh}
button,input,textarea{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
.wrap{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 32px));margin:0 auto}
header{padding:48px 0 24px}
.eyebrow{letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--accent)}
h1{margin:.35rem 0 .65rem;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,4.9rem);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.045em}
.lead{font-size:clamp(1.02rem,2vw,1.22rem);color:var(--muted);max-width:820px;line-height:1.6}
.badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.badge{padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);color:#cfe0f3;font-size:.9rem}
.dashboard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:18px;margin:26px 0 20px}
.panel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(19,37,59,.94),rgba(10,24,42,.94));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.progress-panel{padding:22px 24px}
.progress-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px}
.bigstat{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.3rem);font-weight:850;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.bar{height:11px;border-radius:999px;background:#071421;overflow:hidden;margin-top:14px;border:1px solid #1e3852}
.bar>span{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));border-radius:999px;transition:width .35s ease}
.note{padding:22px 24px;line-height:1.55;color:#c8d7e7}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;padding:10px 0 58px}
.section-card{padding:22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}
.section-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#42698f}
.secno{font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);font-weight:800}
.section-card h2{font-size:1.35rem;margin:.45rem 0 .55rem;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.section-card p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.48;min-height:44px}
.card-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.pill{font-size:.82rem;color:#bdd0e3}
.primary,.ghost,.choice,.mini{border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);background:#132b45}
.primary{padding:11px 16px;border-color:#3c7f83;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1b625f,#154c4d);font-weight:750}
.ghost{padding:10px 14px;background:transparent}
.mini{padding:7px 10px;font-size:.82rem;background:#0b1a2b}
.primary:hover,.ghost:hover,.mini:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.quiz-shell{display:none;padding:24px 0 60px}
.quiz-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.quiz-heading{padding:22px 24px;margin-bottom:14px}
.quiz-heading h2{margin:.2rem 0 .3rem;font-size:clamp(1.65rem,3vw,2.45rem);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.qnav{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.qdot{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0a1929;color:#abc0d5;font-size:.82rem}
.qdot.active{outline:2px solid var(--accent);color:white}
.qdot.done{background:#123a39;border-color:#2f716d;color:#dbfff9}
.qdot.review{background:#3a2c17;border-color:#7a5d2d;color:#ffe8b7}
.question-card{padding:clamp(20px,4vw,34px)}
.qtype{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;color:#c9d8e7;font-size:.82rem}
.qtext{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.4vw,1.8rem);line-height:1.35;margin:20px 0 18px;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.choices{display:grid;gap:10px}
.choice{text-align:left;padding:15px 16px;background:#0b1b2d;line-height:1.4;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s,transform .12s}
.choice:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateX(2px);border-color:#4a708f}
.choice:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.92}
.choice.correct{border-color:#3ba579;background:#11392f}
.choice.wrong{border-color:#a94c55;background:#3b2029}
.answer-box{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:stretch;flex-wrap:wrap}
.answer-box input,.answer-box textarea{flex:1 1 380px;background:#071421;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 15px;outline:none}
.answer-box textarea{min-height:135px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5}
.answer-box input:focus,.answer-box textarea:focus{border-color:#5e91bd;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(94,145,189,.13)}
.feedback{margin-top:18px;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0a1929;line-height:1.55}
.feedback.good{border-color:#2e7e63}.feedback.bad{border-color:#8f4650}
.feedback strong.goodtxt{color:var(--good)} .feedback strong.badtxt{color:var(--bad)}
.model{margin-top:14px;padding:15px 16px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent2);background:#0a1929;border-radius:8px;color:#d9e7f4;line-height:1.55}
.selfgrade{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
.source{margin-top:20px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.source-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#bdd0e3;font-size:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.slide-img{width:100%;max-height:720px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #36536f;background:#04101c;cursor:zoom-in}
.no-visual{padding:15px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.qactions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.scoreline{color:#bfd2e3;font-size:.9rem}
.complete{display:none;margin-top:14px;padding:20px 22px;border:1px solid #377c70;border-radius:18px;background:#0e302d}
.complete h3{margin:0 0 6px}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.86);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;z-index:30}
.modal.open{display:flex}.modal img{max-width:96vw;max-height:92vh;border-radius:12px}.modal button{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px}
.footer{padding:20px 0 45px;color:#7991a9;font-size:.85rem}
.hidden{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:760px){.dashboard,.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.progress-row{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.section-card p{min-height:0}.qactions{align-items:stretch}.qactions>*{flex:1}.quiz-top{align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="home">
  <header class="wrap">
    <div class="eyebrow">Ortho 2 · Midterm Practice</div>
    <h1>Fresh slide-based study.</h1>
    <p class="lead">A fully refreshed question bank built from your uploaded Ortho 2 lectures and lab materials. Each section now includes <b>12 multiple-choice questions, 2 fill-in-the-blank active-recall prompts, and 1 short-answer active-recall prompt.</b></p>
    <div class="badges">
      <span class="badge">165 fresh questions</span><span class="badge">11 sections</span><span class="badge">Original lecture-slide visuals</span><span class="badge">Progress saves in this browser</span>
    </div>
  </header>
  <main class="wrap">
    <div class="dashboard">
      <section class="panel progress-panel">
        <div class="progress-row">
          <div><div class="eyebrow">Your progress</div><div id="totalStat" class="bigstat">0 / 165</div></div>
          <div id="totalScore" class="muted">No graded answers yet</div>
        </div>
        <div class="bar"><span id="totalBar"></span></div>
      </section>
      <section class="panel note"><b>Active-recall rule:</b> lecture visuals stay hidden until you answer or reveal the short-answer key, so the slide itself does not cue you before retrieval.</section>
    </div>
    <section id="sectionGrid" class="grid"></section>
  </main>
  <footer class="wrap footer">Questions are based on your uploaded Ortho 2 course sources. PowerPoint/PDF visuals are direct renders of the lecture slides/pages.</footer>
</div>

<div id="quiz" class="quiz-shell">
  <main class="wrap">
    <div class="quiz-top">
      <button class="ghost" id="backHome">← All sections</button>
      <button class="ghost" id="resetSection">Reset this section</button>
    </div>
    <section class="panel quiz-heading">
      <div id="quizEyebrow" class="eyebrow"></div>
      <h2 id="quizTitle"></h2>
      <div class="progress-row">
        <div id="quizDesc" class="muted"></div>
        <div id="sectionScore" class="scoreline"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="bar"><span id="sectionBar"></span></div>
      <div id="qnav" class="qnav"></div>
    </section>
    <section id="questionCard" class="panel question-card"></section>
    <section id="completeBox" class="complete">
      <h3>Section complete.</h3>
      <div id="completeText" class="muted"></div>
    </section>
  </main>
</div>

<div id="modal" class="modal" aria-hidden="true">
  <button id="closeModal" class="ghost">Close ✕</button><img id="modalImg" alt="Enlarged lecture slide">
</div>

<script>
